EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Benchmark Integrity

Benchmark Integrity workflow for coding agents. Use when a new run is compared with the frozen board.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Require matching case, rubric, model, protocol, and coverage identities; never alter history.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.
